source: Weekly refresh by Claude (scheduled task). Edit freely; the next refresh replaces this file.

items.title: 947 Ride Joburg (Sun 22 Nov): same day cyclist gallery
items.why: Thousands of riders start and finish at FNB Stadium this Sunday and most of them will look for photos of themselves that evening.
items.tip: Post where you will stand on Saturday, shoot the finish straight, then drop a gallery link the same night and ask riders to tag their club.

items.title: Black Friday (27 Nov) mini-session that doubles as a Christmas gift
items.why: People are planning gifts now, and a clear offer with a cut-off date gets saved and sent to partners.
items.tip: Slide 1 the offer, slides 2 to 4 sample shots, last slide how to book and the deadline. Pin it to your profile until Friday.

items.title: Festive lights and markets mini-series for local brands
items.why: KAMERS opens on 24 Nov and the Joburg Zoo Festival of Lights opens on 26 Nov, so cosy festive content is peaking right as these start.
items.tip: Film a 3 clip vendor story at a market, then offer the stall the edited reel as a paid promo package.

items.title: Raw clip to final edit on the beat drop
items.why: The freeze-frame then reveal transition is one of the most copied formats this month and it shows your grading skill in seconds.
items.tip: Start on a flat ungraded car or sport clip, freeze on the beat, then cut to the finished graded version.

items.title: 'Shoot loading 0% to 100%' progress reel
items.why: Loading bar videos that climb from 0 to 100 percent are trending and keep people watching to the end.
items.tip: Add an on-screen percentage over clips of gear prep, setup, the shoot and the final frame at 100 percent.

items.title: Slow runway walk-up to the product for brand clients
items.why: A slow, dramatic walk down an aisle that ends on a product is a popular format that brands can easily picture for themselves.
items.tip: Shoot at 60fps or higher, keep the camera low, and land the last frame on the logo or the car badge.

items.title: Bait-and-switch hook: promise one thing, flip it
items.why: Two beat skits that set up an expectation and then twist it are getting strong rewatches and shares.
items.tip: Open with 'the perfect sunset shoot' and cut to you standing in the rain, then end on the moody shot that worked better.

items.title: Say your keywords out loud and on screen
items.why: Instagram now reads on-screen text and voiceover to decide who sees a reel, not only captions and hashtags.
items.tip: Say 'Johannesburg car photographer' in the first few seconds and put it in a text overlay too.

items.title: Year-end function teaser for venues and caterers
items.why: Late November to mid December is peak work party season in South Africa and venues want content now.
items.tip: Tag the venue and caterer so they reshare, and pin a comment saying which December dates are still open.

items.title: 12 days of FOM: an early Christmas countdown
items.why: Christmas countdown content is already trending before December and daily stories bring people back to your profile.
items.tip: Post one favourite 2026 shot a day with a poll or slider sticker, and finish with a booking link for January.
